cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

mechanism: A confidently declares a cupboard complete, then adapts the definition of completion around the customer demands to keep the handover cooperative.
confusable: Unlike mere poor workmanship, A repeatedly markets missing work as a deliberate finished form; borrowed authority yields the completion terms to B needs.
comparison: A paid installation and sample shelf differ from a budget document redefined around a board recommendation.
seedUse: Use D41-a loose shelves/kit/drill/sample and S02-a claiming customer-driven changes as the plan.
